name: data-list-skeleton
title: Data List Skeleton
description: A DataList and its ListToolbar while they load, in the list's own geometry (table rows or grid cards), without loading the list.

meta.whenToUse: A route's or Suspense fallback's loading state for a DataList page (rows, grid cards, the toolbar).
meta.whenNotToUse: DataList's own `loading` (a list already on screen refetching).
